balance_reconciliations_adjustment_consi.name: balance_reconciliations_adjustment_consistency
balance_reconciliations_adjustment_consi.value: (("balance_reconciliations"."reconciliation_status" = 'reconciled_with_adjustment' AND "balance_reconciliations"."approved_adjustment_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("balance_reconciliations"."reconciliation_status" <> 'reconciled_with_adjustment' AND "balance_reconciliations"."approved_adjustment_transaction_id" IS NULL))

balance_reconciliations_timestamp_format.name: balance_reconciliations_timestamp_format
balance_reconciliations_timestamp_format.value: "balance_reconciliations"."created_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "balance_reconciliations"."updated_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND ("balance_reconciliations"."voided_at_utc" IS NULL OR "balance_reconciliations"."voided_at_utc" LIKE '%Z') AND ("balance_reconciliations"."superseded_at_utc" IS NULL OR "balance_reconciliations"."superseded_at_utc" LIKE '%Z')

debt_transactions_reversal_relationship.name: debt_transactions_reversal_relationship
debt_transactions_reversal_relationship.value: (("debt_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'reversal' AND "debt_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("debt_transactions"."transaction_type" <> 'reversal' AND "debt_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NULL))

debt_transactions_no_self_relationship.name: debt_transactions_no_self_relationship
debt_transactions_no_self_relationship.value: ("debt_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NULL OR "debt_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" <> "debt_transactions"."id") AND ("debt_transactions"."supersedes_transaction_id" IS NULL OR "debt_transactions"."supersedes_transaction_id" <> "debt_transactions"."id")

debts_refinance_not_self.name: debts_refinance_not_self
debts_refinance_not_self.value: ("debts"."refinanced_from_debt_id" IS NULL OR "debts"."refinanced_from_debt_id" <> "debts"."id") AND ("debts"."refinanced_into_debt_id" IS NULL OR "debts"."refinanced_into_debt_id" <> "debts"."id")

debts_timestamp_format.name: debts_timestamp_format
debts_timestamp_format.value: "debts"."created_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "debts"."updated_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND ("debts"."archived_at_utc" IS NULL OR "debts"."archived_at_utc" LIKE '%Z')

import_batches_timestamp_format.name: import_batches_timestamp_format
import_batches_timestamp_format.value: "import_batches"."imported_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "import_batches"."created_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "import_batches"."updated_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND ("import_batches"."source_workbook_modified_at_utc" IS NULL OR "import_batches"."source_workbook_modified_at_utc" LIKE '%Z')

payment_schedule_overrides_date_format.name: payment_schedule_overrides_date_format
payment_schedule_overrides_date_format.value: "payment_schedule_overrides"."satisfied_due_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND "payment_schedule_overrides"."confirmed_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "payment_schedule_overrides"."created_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND ("payment_schedule_overrides"."removed_at_utc" IS NULL OR "payment_schedule_overrides"."removed_at_utc" LIKE '%Z')

payoff_scenarios_timestamp_format.name: payoff_scenarios_timestamp_format
payoff_scenarios_timestamp_format.value: "payoff_scenarios"."created_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "payoff_scenarios"."updated_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND ("payoff_scenarios"."archived_at_utc" IS NULL OR "payoff_scenarios"."archived_at_utc" LIKE '%Z')

refinance_events_nonnegative_amounts.name: refinance_events_nonnegative_amounts
refinance_events_nonnegative_amounts.value: "refinance_events"."pre_refinance_principal_cents" >= 0 AND "refinance_events"."new_refinanced_principal_cents" >= 0 AND "refinance_events"."financed_fees_cents" >= 0 AND "refinance_events"."cash_fees_cents" >= 0 AND ("refinance_events"."lender_payoff_balance_cents" IS NULL OR "refinance_events"."lender_payoff_balance_cents" >= 0)

staged_import_rows_timestamp_format.name: staged_import_rows_timestamp_format
staged_import_rows_timestamp_format.value: "staged_import_rows"."created_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND "staged_import_rows"."updated_at_utc" LIKE '%Z' AND ("staged_import_rows"."reviewed_at_utc" IS NULL OR "staged_import_rows"."reviewed_at_utc" LIKE '%Z')
